absentFields.sessionid: Not present in this Actor. Public videos only.

actorOutput.title: Output schema of Social media scraper

output.cardinality: unknown; one Run per URL is expected to yield one item, but the schema does not constrain it

speech2text.title: Cost-Effective Audio-to-Text (Auto)
speech2text.note: Documented as $0.002 to $0.0045 per minute depending on plan; any duration under one minute is billed as one minute.

pricing.storePageClaimScope: Covers the dataset-item event only; it does not include the speech2text event.

limits.freePlanSource: Actor README: free users can only try video transcription with a duration of no more than 5 minutes.
limits.paidPlanDurationLimit: Documented as not limited by duration.
limits.audioOnly: The Actor transcribes audio; text burned into video frames is not extracted.

video_php.detail: Three attempts returned Meta's generic error page while watch/?v= on the same video id succeeded.

video.detail: Bare /videos/<id>/ returned Not Found, while /<page>/videos/<same id>/ succeeded in the same minute.

short_link.detail: No fb.watch code was available; the client validator accepts and forwards the form unchanged.

liveVerification.transientFailureObservation: 2 of 11 otherwise-valid attempts returned actor_error with errMsg 'no audio url found' while the same URL succeeded on retry; treat that errMsg as retryable.
defectsFixedAfterLiveTesting: Java readDotEnv stripped only double quotes, so a single-quoted .env value failed charge-cap validation.
Java emitted empty strings for absent error/title/nickname instead of null.
confirmed: The pinned build id was used by the service; client build verification passed on every Run.
share, watch, page_video, and reel URLs each returned the same 42.261 s video with a populated text and 13 segments.
The submitted URL is echoed verbatim in the item url field; no form is rewritten upstream.
All 17 declared dataset fields were present, including likesCount and shareCount.
duration is seconds (42.261); createTime is Unix seconds (1791609487).
segments are {start, end, text} in seconds; 13 segments, start <= end.
Billing is the two-event model; 42.261 s was billed as one started minute.
A failing Run still writes one dataset item and is charged $0.001 without a speech2text event.
All four reference clients completed a live Run and agreed on status, exit code, and JSON keys.
Batch execution mapped rowId to the CSV line number and reported the same total as its own estimate.

unverified: Whether a Run always returns exactly one dataset item per submitted URL.
Real response shape for an unplayable, private, deleted, or region-locked video.
Whether errMsg and a non-empty text can coexist, and which one is authoritative.

Whether fb.watch short links are accepted and resolved by the Actor; short links cannot be minted outside the Facebook apps, so the form is accepted by the clients but unproven upstream (share links were confirmed live on 2026-10-28).
Whether /video.php?v= and bare /videos/<id>/ resolve for any video: three attempts each hit Facebook-side errors, so the Actor's handling of those pages is unknown rather than disproved.
Whether a legacy (pre-reel) page upload behaves differently from the reel-sourced id used in the 2026-10-28 matrix.
Whether the speech2text event is charged when a video has no speech or transcription fails.
Whether likesCount and shareCount are populated on every item type.
Bulk ordering does not apply because this Actor has no bulk mode.
Whether a video without an audio track yields a usable audioUrl.
Whether CDN throughput is throttled above a few concurrent downloads.
